yale-sports-crewneck-golf.note: Morse men and women, named for Samuel F. B. Morse, inventor of Morse code and a Yale graduate, may find this heather gray crewneck sweatshirt speaks plainly. Navy YALE and GOLF text, with a Yale Y lettermark, meets a ribbed collar, cuffs, and waistband in an agreeable study-by-the-fire composition.

yale-sports-crewneck-volleyball.note: Pauli Murray College, opened in 2017 and named for Pauli Murray, civil-rights lawyer and Yale law graduate, here is a heather gray crewneck sweatshirt with navy blue YALE and VOLLEYBALL lettering and a Yale Y emblem on the front. A clear, spirited mark for the college’s newer chapter among these old stones.

yale-sports-hoodie-baseball.note: Pierson College, named for Abraham Pierson, Yale’s first rector, this heather gray pullover hoodie carries a navy YALE BASEBALL graphic and Yale Y logo. Its drawstring hood and front kangaroo pocket lend practical comfort, while the long sleeves make it well suited to the courtyard when daylight begins its retreat.

yale-sports-hoodie-diving.note: Saybrookers, named for Old Saybrook, the Collegiate School’s first home, and carved from the Memorial Quadrangle, here is a heather gray Yale Diving pullover hoodie. Navy collegiate lettering, a drawstring hood, front kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs, and hem make it ready for weather both ordinary and faintly legendary.

yale-sports-hoodie-golf.note: Silliman College, named for Benjamin Silliman, the scientist, may take a measured turn toward the green in this heather gray Yale Golf pullover hoodie. Navy collegiate lettering accompanies the drawstring hood, front kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs, and hem—a composed arrangement for wandering from the laboratory of the day into evening.

yale-sports-hoodie-hockey.note: Timothy Dwight College, named for Timothy Dwight, a Yale president, here is a heather gray Yale Hockey pullover hoodie with navy collegiate-style YALE and HOCKEY graphic and Yale Y emblem. Its drawstring hood, long sleeves, and front kangaroo pocket offer sturdy form for the brisk passage across the courtyard.

yale-sports-hoodie-soccer.note: Trumbull College, named for Jonathan Trumbull, governor of Connecticut, may step onto the field—or simply into the evening—in this heather gray pullover hoodie. Navy YALE SOCCER lettering and an interlocking Yale Y logo mark the front, while the drawstring hood and kangaroo pocket keep the composition agreeably grounded.

yale-sports-hoodie-swimming.note: Benjamin Franklin College, opened in 2017—Franklin having received an honorary Yale degree in 1753—here is a heather gray pullover hoodie with navy YALE SWIMMING lettering and Yale Y logo. A drawstring hood, kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs, and hem complete this practical little piece of collegiate pageantry.

yale-sports-hoodie-tennis.note: Berkeley College, named for Bishop George Berkeley, an early benefactor of Yale, here is a heather gray pullover hoodie bearing navy Yale Tennis graphics across the chest. Its drawstring hood, front kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs, and hem lend a quietly athletic air, suitable for the path home through the old stones.

yale-sports-t-shirt-field-hockey.note: Branforders, with Harkness Tower rising from your courtyard and the Memorial Quadrangle beneath your feet, this heather gray short-sleeve Yale sports T-shirt offers a direct herald. Large navy YALE lettering, FIELD HOCKEY text, and a Yale Y emblem sit on the front—clean, spirited, and ready for the day’s small adventures.

yale-uncle-hoodie.note: Fellow Davenporters, named for John Davenport, a founder of the New Haven Colony, here is a navy pullover hoodie with a large white Yale University Uncle graphic across the chest. The drawstring hood and kangaroo pocket add practical ease, making this a genial layer for family visits and candlelit college corridors.
